issue_link: [ZOOKEEPER-3656] SyncRequestProcessor doesn't update lastFlushTime correctly on observers - ASF JIRA
fix_link: ZOOKEEPER-3656: Properly set lastFlushTime when flushing by hammerlefb · Pull Request #1189 · apache/zookeeper
title: SyncRequestProcessor doesn't update lastFlushTime correctly on observers
description:
This issues was introduced in ZOOKEEPER-3311. The lastFlushTime used to decide the batch window is not updated correctly for the observer case when the nextProcessor is always be null.

This can cause observers to fall behind and their sync queue to grow indefinitely.
